## Explore a PK Model

A one-compartment oral model, live. Drag the sliders to see how dose and disposition shape the concentration–time curve and the exposure metrics.

```{=html}
<div class="pk-sim">
  <div class="pk-controls">
    <label>Dose <b><span id="pk-dose-v">100</span> mg</b>
      <input type="range" id="pk-dose" min="25" max="500" step="25" value="100" aria-label="Dose in mg"></label>
    <label>k<sub>a</sub> <b><span id="pk-ka-v">1.0</span> /h</b>
      <input type="range" id="pk-ka" min="0.2" max="3" step="0.1" value="1.0" aria-label="Absorption rate constant"></label>
    <label>CL <b><span id="pk-cl-v">5.0</span> L/h</b>
      <input type="range" id="pk-cl" min="1" max="20" step="0.5" value="5" aria-label="Clearance"></label>
    <label>V <b><span id="pk-v-v">30</span> L</b>
      <input type="range" id="pk-v" min="10" max="80" step="5" value="30" aria-label="Volume of distribution"></label>
  </div>
  <div class="pk-plot">
    <svg id="pk-svg" viewBox="0 0 660 340" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" role="img" aria-label="Simulated concentration versus time curve"></svg>
  </div>
  <div class="pk-metrics">
    <div><strong id="pk-cmax">–</strong><span>C<sub>max</sub> (mg/L)</span></div>
    <div><strong id="pk-tmax">–</strong><span>T<sub>max</sub> (h)</span></div>
    <div><strong id="pk-auc">–</strong><span>AUC<sub>0–∞</sub> (mg·h/L)</span></div>
    <div><strong id="pk-thalf">–</strong><span>t½ (h)</span></div>
  </div>
</div>
<p class="pk-note">Decorative one-compartment oral model (first-order absorption, F = 1) for illustration only — not derived from real study data.</p>
<script>
(function () {
  var svg = document.getElementById('pk-svg');
  if (!svg) return;
  var NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  var W = 660, H = 340, m = {l: 56, r: 18, t: 20, b: 44};
  var pw = W - m.l - m.r, ph = H - m.t - m.b, TMAX = 24;
  var ids = ['dose','ka','cl','v'];
  function val(id){ return parseFloat(document.getElementById('pk-'+id).value); }
  function el(tag, attrs){ var e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); for (var k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); return e; }
  function conc(t, dose, ka, cl, v){
    var ke = cl / v; if (Math.abs(ka - ke) < 1e-4) ka = ke * 1.0001;
    return (dose * ka) / (v * (ka - ke)) * (Math.exp(-ke * t) - Math.exp(-ka * t));
  }
  function render(){
    var dose = val('dose'), ka = val('ka'), cl = val('cl'), v = val('v'), ke = cl / v;
    document.getElementById('pk-dose-v').textContent = dose;
    document.getElementById('pk-ka-v').textContent = ka.toFixed(1);
    document.getElementById('pk-cl-v').textContent = cl.toFixed(1);
    document.getElementById('pk-v-v').textContent = v;
    var tmax = Math.log(ka / ke) / (ka - ke);
    var cmax = conc(tmax, dose, ka, cl, v);
    var auc = dose / cl, thalf = Math.log(2) / ke;
    document.getElementById('pk-cmax').textContent = cmax.toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById('pk-tmax').textContent = tmax.toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById('pk-auc').textContent = auc.toFixed(1);
    document.getElementById('pk-thalf').textContent = thalf.toFixed(1);
    var ymax = cmax * 1.15 || 1;
    var X = function(t){ return m.l + (t / TMAX) * pw; };
    var Y = function(c){ return m.t + ph - (c / ymax) * ph; };
    while (svg.firstChild) svg.removeChild(svg.firstChild);
    // grid + y ticks
    var i, ny = 4;
    for (i = 0; i <= ny; i++){
      var cy = m.t + ph - (i / ny) * ph, cv = (ymax * i / ny);
      svg.appendChild(el('line', {x1: m.l, y1: cy, x2: m.l + pw, y2: cy, stroke: '#e2e8ee', 'stroke-width': 1}));
      var ty = el('text', {x: m.l - 8, y: cy + 4, 'text-anchor': 'end', 'font-size': 11, fill: '#5f6f7c'});
      ty.textContent = cv.toFixed(cv < 10 ? 1 : 0); svg.appendChild(ty);
    }
    // x ticks
    for (i = 0; i <= 6; i++){
      var t = i * 4, cx = X(t);
      svg.appendChild(el('line', {x1: cx, y1: m.t + ph, x2: cx, y2: m.t + ph + 5, stroke: '#c9d4dd', 'stroke-width': 1}));
      var tx = el('text', {x: cx, y: m.t + ph + 20, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 11, fill: '#5f6f7c'});
      tx.textContent = t; svg.appendChild(tx);
    }
    // axis labels
    var xl = el('text', {x: m.l + pw / 2, y: H - 6, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 12, fill: '#33434f', 'font-weight': 600}); xl.textContent = 'Time (h)'; svg.appendChild(xl);
    var yl = el('text', {x: 14, y: m.t + ph / 2, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 12, fill: '#33434f', 'font-weight': 600, transform: 'rotate(-90 14 ' + (m.t + ph / 2) + ')'}); yl.textContent = 'Concentration (mg/L)'; svg.appendChild(yl);
    // curve
    var d = '', a = '', n = 160, first = true;
    for (i = 0; i <= n; i++){
      var tt = (i / n) * TMAX, c = conc(tt, dose, ka, cl, v); if (c < 0) c = 0;
      var px = X(tt), py = Y(c);
      d += (first ? 'M' : 'L') + px.toFixed(1) + ' ' + py.toFixed(1) + ' ';
      a += (first ? 'M' : 'L') + px.toFixed(1) + ' ' + py.toFixed(1) + ' ';
      first = false;
    }
    a += 'L' + X(TMAX).toFixed(1) + ' ' + Y(0) + ' L' + X(0).toFixed(1) + ' ' + Y(0) + ' Z';
    svg.appendChild(el('path', {d: a, fill: '#12a6b8', 'fill-opacity': 0.10, stroke: 'none'}));
    svg.appendChild(el('path', {d: d, fill: 'none', stroke: '#1769aa', 'stroke-width': 2.6, 'stroke-linejoin': 'round'}));
    // Tmax marker
    svg.appendChild(el('line', {x1: X(tmax), y1: Y(cmax), x2: X(tmax), y2: Y(0), stroke: '#12a6b8', 'stroke-width': 1.4, 'stroke-dasharray': '4 4'}));
    svg.appendChild(el('circle', {cx: X(tmax), cy: Y(cmax), r: 4.5, fill: '#0a1a2f', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 1.5}));
  }
  ids.forEach(function(id){ document.getElementById('pk-' + id).addEventListener('input', render); });
  render();
})();
</script>
```

## Professional Snapshot

**Associate Study Coordinator (PK/TK) — Labcorp, Bangalore**
*April 2021 – Present*

I support preclinical, translational and early-phase programs through independent PK analysis, analysis-ready dataset construction and QC, PK/PD and population-modelling workflows, and sponsor-ready reporting. Day to day, I work alongside bioanalytical scientists, study directors, toxicologists and sponsor PK leads.

Along the way I've helped speed up interim PK/PD analysis turnaround by around **25%**, and as Lead Trainer I've helped cut analyst onboarding time by roughly **50%**.
